characters.name: Miss Nova
characters.appearance: Young female with a fair complexion, long curly brown hair, and a bindi. She has a robotic, cybernetic neck piece.
characters.wardrobe: Textured blue jacket over a grey top, with delicate layered necklaces.
characters.demeanor: Calm, helpful, and slightly robotic but friendly.

characters.name: Rahul
characters.appearance: Young male with a fair complexion and curly dark hair. He has a clean-shaven face with a slight stubble.
characters.demeanor: Initially confused and frustrated, transitioning to curious and convinced.

scenes.supernova_script:
Rahul says: My boss told me to circle back, so I literally started spinning in circles.
Miss Nova says: Circle back just means to discuss a topic again later. I am Miss Nova, your personal AI English teacher.
Rahul says: Oh, that is what it means. But how do I learn? I get so nervous speaking English, and I have no time.
scenes.scene_summary:
- Hook: Relatable workplace English confusion.
- Introduces Miss Nova and names English early.
- Sets up the time and confidence objection.
scenes.supernova_on_screen_text: MY BOSS TOLD ME TO CIRCLE BACK SO I LITERALLY STARTED SPINNING IN CIRCLES CIRCLE BACK JUST MEANS TO DISCUSS A TOPIC AGAIN LATER I AM MISS NOVA YOUR PERSONAL AI ENGLISH TEACHER OH THAT IS WHAT IT MEANS BUT HOW DO I LEARN I GET SO NERVOUS SPEAKING ENGLISH AND I HAVE NO TIME

scenes.supernova_script: Miss Nova says: With Supernova AI, you learn by actually speaking. I analyze your exact level and build a personalized plan just for you. Make a thousand mistakes at three in the morning, I will never judge you.
scenes.scene_summary:
- Delivers beat (a) Personalization.
- Delivers beat (b) Privacy and no-judgement.
- Emphasizes speaking over reading.
scenes.supernova_on_screen_text: WITH SUPERNOVA AI YOU LEARN BY ACTUALLY SPEAKING I ANALYZE YOUR EXACT LEVEL AND BUILD A PERSONALIZED PLAN JUST FOR YOU MAKE A THOUSAND MISTAKES AT THREE IN THE MORNING I WILL NEVER JUDGE YOU

scenes.supernova_script:
Rahul says: Really? But what do I have to do?
Miss Nova says: Stop scrolling for hours. Just practice speaking with me for fifteen minutes a day. Download Supernova AI, and you will start seeing visible progress in your confidence within a month.
scenes.scene_summary:
- Negative and positive time anchors.
- Soft, hedged progress expectation (no guarantees).
- Clear download CTA without a hard price.
